outgoingFlows.description: Infection with TB due to contact with infectious individuals (smear-positive and smear-negative).
Waning from recent to remote latent infection after two years.
Rapid progression to smear-positive active TB.
Rapid progression to smear-negative active TB.
Rapid progression to extrapulmonary active TB.
Reactivation (slow progression) to smear-positive active TB.
Reactivation (slow progression) to smear-negative active TB.
Reactivation (slow progression) to extrapulmonary active TB.

uncertainty_analysis.methodologyNotes: This task is **parameter uncertainty quantification**: documenting uncertainty about **numerical parameter values** in the .compmodel (not structural or stochastic uncertainty). Confidence is **mostly Unknown** unless a small built-in heuristic matches the disease name (COVID-19, Malaria, HIV) and parameter name substrings — assigning High/Medium/Low requires curated literature ranges or expert review; see Phase 1 README (Validity & limitations).
